title: Python: File Reading
description: Write a Python program that reads from a simulated file (list of strings) and counts lines, words, and characters.

codeTemplate.py:
lines = [
    "Hello world",
    "Python is great",
    "File processing is fun",
]

line_count = len(lines)
word_count = sum(len(line.split()) for line in lines)
char_count = sum(len(line) for line in lines)

print(f"Lines: {line_count}")
print(f"Words: {word_count}")
print(f"Characters: {char_count}")

print("\nUppercased:")
for line in lines:
    print(line.upper())

verificationTest: output.includes('Lines: 3') && output.includes('Words: 9') && output.includes('Characters: 48') && output.includes('Uppercased:') && output.includes('HELLO WORLD')
hints: Use `len()` to get counts for sequences
`line.split()` splits a line into words by whitespace
Use a for loop to process each line individually
